name: CUDA
description: NVIDIA's parallel computing platform. The dominant ecosystem for LLM training.

name: ROCm
description: AMD's open computing platform. Improving rapidly but less mature than CUDA.

name: Metal / MPS
description: Apple's GPU acceleration framework. MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) is PyTorch's interface.

name: oneAPI
description: Intel's cross-architecture computing framework. Gaudi support via PyTorch extension.
